SOURCE ACCESS: every document was downloaded directly from www.smbci.com with a plain browser User-Agent; no bot challenge, no Internet Archive needed. The bank's site rewrites 'btpn' to 'smbci' in some link URLs on its English pages, which makes those links 404; the original file names (with 'btpn') were used and are the source_url values. The old www.btpn.com domain no longer resolves.

SCOPE (consolidated vs bank-only): all fy.* money figures are consolidated: the Bank plus PT Bank BTPN Syariah Tbk (70% owned, itself listed as BTPS), PT BTPN Syariah Ventura (the IR site lists an Aug 2026 disclosure titled 'pencabutan izin usaha BTPNS Ventura', i.e. licence revocation; image-only PDF, not read) and, from the end of March 2024, PT Oto Multiartha and PT Summit Oto Finance (51% each). FY2024 growth is distorted by the OTO/SOF acquisition: financing receivables of Rp29.4tn were added to loans and goodwill rose to Rp1.1tn. BTPS's own numbers belong to the separate BTPS file and must not be mixed in.

DEFINITIONS: loans_gross = the bank's printed group 'Loans' total = conventional loans + sharia financing (+ OTO/SOF financing receivables from 2024), gross before allowance. deposits = the bank's 'Deposits from Customers (including temporary syirkah funds)' = third-party funds incl. BTPN Syariah mudharabah funds (about Rp7.6-9.9tn a year), excluding accrued interest. Both were checked line by line against each year's audited FS face. Note: BBNI.json's FY2019-2020 deposits exclude syirkah funds; here they are included because that is how this bank reports its third-party funds and its LDR/CASA.

RATIO BASIS: the FY ratios (CAR, NPL, ROA, ROE, NIM, BOPO, CIR, LDR) come from the AR 'Financial Highlights - Financial Ratios' table and are CONSOLIDATED: they match the consolidated KPMM (FY2025 29.31% consolidated vs 27.63% bank-only, AR2025 PDF p. 184) and group NIM/ROE, and the FY2022 deck labels the same series 'Key Financial Ratios - Consolidated'. The OJK published statements print a different, BANK-ONLY ratio table (e.g. 30 Jun 2026 NIM 3.78, LDR 126.42, CIR 61.19 vs group NIM 6.89). CoC and NPL coverage come from the analyst decks (group loan book). LAR is not disclosed in any document used. FY2020 CoC and NPL coverage are null because the FY2020/FY2021 decks could not be found on smbci.com or in the Internet Archive.

RESTATED DEFINITIONS: AR2022 restated BOPO and CIR for 2019-2021 to the SEOJK 9/SEOJK.03/2020 presentation (AR2022 PDF p. 15 note 7). The stored FY2020/FY2021 BOPO (85.5/76.0) and CIR (53.9/49.3) are the restated values from AR2023 PDF p. 15 (identical in AR2022); AR2021 originally printed BOPO 89.5 (2020) and 80.5 (2021), and AR2021 PDF p. 7 quotes a CIR of 63.2% for 2021 on the old definition. Balance-sheet and profit figures were never restated: each later FS repeats the prior year unchanged (checked FY2019-FY2024).

FY2019 / MERGER: BTPN merged with PT Bank Sumitomo Mitsui Indonesia effective 1 Feb 2019 and issued 2,296,846,112 shares to SMBC (FS2021 Note 27). FY2019 is the first post-merger balance sheet (TA Rp181.6tn); the FY2019 FS shows FY2018 for BTPN alone (Rp101.3tn), so FY2018->FY2019 growth is not meaningful. In Aug 2019 SMBC sold 400,000,000 existing shares at Rp3,600 to meet the free-float rule (AR2025 PDF p. 111): a secondary sale, not a new issue. FY2020 FS repeats FY2019 unchanged except P&L reclassifications (Note 48).

SHARES / CORPORATE ACTIONS since 2019: no split, reverse split or bonus issue (the last split was 1:5 on 28 Mar 2011). One rights issue: PMHMETD II, ex-right 28 Feb 2024 (see corporate_actions). Other share-count changes are not corporate actions of the listed types: MESOP issuances 2019-2021 (8,148,916,869 -> 8,149,106,869), transfer of 2,633,202 treasury shares to material risk takers (Aug 2021) and resale of treasury shares to the market, and the withdrawal (cancellation) of 92,292,198 treasury shares approved by the EGMS of 7 Dec 2023 and listed on 22 Feb 2024 (AR2025 PDF p. 111; FS2024 Note 1c). Rights Issue I (Dec 2010) is before the window.

EPS / SHARE_BASIS: no splits in the window, so share_basis only documents the date (period end for FY figures, announcement date for dividends). EPS x year-end shares matches profit within 0.2% in 2020-2023 and 1.0% in 2025; FY2024 is 5.6% off because the reported EPS uses weighted-average shares (10,087,089,587) after the March 2024 rights issue (validation_ack). The FY2023 EPS (293) was not restated for the rights bonus element in FS2024.

DIVIDENDS: no dividend out of FY2019 (AGMS 2020), FY2020 (AGMS 22 Apr 2021) or FY2021 (AGMS 21 Apr 2022) profit; payout_ratio 0 for 2020/2021 with the AGMS summaries as source. FY2022-FY2025: one final cash dividend each, 20% of profit, no interim or special dividends. The FY2023 dividend was paid on 10,645,945,748 shares including the March 2024 rights shares, hence the dps_total mismatch against FY2023 year-end shares (validation_ack). AR2025 prints the FY2022 payment date as 11 May 2023; the bank's announcement says 12 May 2023 (stored).

YEAR-END PRICE FY2024 DOUBTFUL: AR2024 (and AR2025, copied) print the 2024 Q4 close as Rp2,610 while the same row's high/low are 2,400/2,220, and the Q1 2024 row is also inconsistent (close 2,370 below low 2,558). A Kontan article of 3 Jul 2025 says the 30 Jun 2025 price of Rp2,520 was about 14.54% above the end-2024 price, which would make the end-2024 close about Rp2,200 (the headline calls it a one-day gain, so this is ambiguous too).
